GPS Camera - Timestamp Photo | Geo Tag Photos, Videos & Location Stamp

Capture photos and videos with accurate GPS location, date, and time using GPS Camera - Timestamp Photo. Whether you're documenting construction work, field inspections, site visits, travel, deliveries, or everyday moments, this app helps you create professional geo-tagged photos and videos with complete location details. Automatically add your address, GPS coordinates, date, time, weather, compass, altitude, and map preview to every photo or video. Organize your work, projects, and travel memories with professional timestamp templates. 📍 GPS Camera with Location Stamp Capture photos and videos with real-time GPS information. • Automatic GPS location • Full address • Latitude & Longitude • Date & Time stamp • Compass direction • Altitude • Weather information • Professional timestamp templates Create professional location-stamped photos and videos with just one tap. 📄 Professional Work Reports Turn your work photos into professional reports within seconds. • Export reports as PDF or Image • Add company logo • Company & project name • Supervisor details • Work title • Report creator information • Automatic date & time • Attach multiple work photos • Ready to share with clients and teams Perfect for engineers, contractors, surveyors, inspectors, maintenance teams, real estate professionals, and field employees. 🎥 GPS Timestamp Video Record HD videos with live GPS details displayed while recording. • GPS location on videos • Date & Time stamp • Address & GPS coordinates • Compass, altitude & weather • Multiple timestamp styles • High-quality video recording Ideal for site inspections, construction progress, travel videos, project updates, and business documentation. 🖼️ Add GPS Stamp to Existing Photos Already have photos in your gallery? Add professional GPS and timestamp information anytime. • Add GPS stamp to gallery photos • Add date & time to existing photos • Display address & GPS coordinates • Apply professional timestamp templates • Save and share instantly Perfect for project records, travel memories, inspections, and documentation. ✏️ Manual Location Editing Need to use a different location? • Edit latitude & longitude • Update address manually • Preview custom location • Perfect for project documentation and reporting 🎨 Custom Timestamp
